body: Lucki shared an update on his Instagram story after he was injured at Complexcon this weekend during an altercation He is recovering and in good spirits but is asking the LAPD for his car and money back… Lucki is asking the LAPD to return his car after the department took it following the incident at ComplexCon. In an update, he says there’s more than $100,000 inside the vehicle, along with his debit card.

source_caption_text:
Lucki shared an update on his Instagram story after he was injured at Complexcon this weekend during an altercation 👀

He is recovering and in good spirits but is asking the LAPD for his car and money back… 

Lucki is asking the LAPD to return his car after the department took it following the incident at ComplexCon. In an update, he says there’s more than $100,000 inside the vehicle, along with his debit card.

The circumstances around the car being taken and when it may be returned haven’t been explained in the post. Lucki had also shared that he was injured at ComplexCon. Hoping he’s recovering and gets his car and belongings back soon 🙏
